records.statement: Coinbase's market-share, Assets-on-Platform share, average USDC held and prediction-market annualized revenue figures are company-reported and partly management-defined. They are not independent third-party measurements; annualized revenue is not recognized Q3 revenue.

The Q3 reporting period ended 2026-09-30, while Coinbase RLUSD availability began 2026-10-28. Q3 USDC balances and revenue cannot establish post-listing RLUSD adoption, USDC displacement or incremental XRP demand.

The $22B average USDC balance held in Coinbase products is a platform balance measure. It is not $22B of new external capital during Q3, not a net-flow measure, and not evidence of XRP purchases or collateral.
